quantization: Float16 profile values; conservative crossing bound from half ULP and local crossing slope. Low-amplitude short-lag correlations may be below saved-profile precision.
selection: Both edges only in uninterrupted frames with exactly one current half-contrast region and contrast >= 0.1 native basal contrast; no interpolation across multiple-domain or homogeneous frames.
spring_coordinate: Fractional material-edge displacement times mean postburn physical circumference; expansion excluded.
